questions.q: Is a brand-new Trailhead Playground actually empty, per this lesson?
options: No — it ships with a small set of pre-loaded sample records, clearly labeled (Sample)
Yes, it is completely empty with zero records of any kind
No, it ships with a full copy of a real company's production data
Yes, and sample data must always be purchased separately
questions.explain: New orgs come pre-loaded with a handful of sample records, like accounts and opportunities marked (Sample), rather than being truly empty.

questions.q: What does this lesson say the Sample Gallery provides, beyond the default sample records?
options: Entire installable sample apps with realistic, pre-populated data, like Coral Cloud Resorts
A way to permanently delete an org
Paid Enterprise Edition upgrades
Access to another student's private org data
questions.explain: The Sample Gallery installs full working sample apps with realistic pre-populated data, going beyond the handful of default sample records.

questions.q: Does Salesforce offer a one-click "reset" button to wipe an existing org back to empty, per this lesson?
options: No — there's no literal reset button for an existing org
Yes, it's found under Company Information
Yes, but only for paid Enterprise Edition orgs
Yes, it's the same button used to reset a password
questions.explain: The lesson is explicit that Salesforce doesn't provide a one-click way to wipe an existing org back to empty.

questions.q: What does "Disconnect" actually do to a Trailhead Playground, according to this lesson?
options: It removes the playground from your Hands-On Orgs list — it does not delete the org itself
It permanently and irreversibly deletes the org from existence
It converts the org into a sandbox
It removes all other users' access but keeps yours
questions.explain: Disconnect only removes a playground from your personal list; it doesn't delete the underlying org.

questions.q: What two steps does this lesson give as the practical equivalent of "resetting" your org?
options: Disconnect the current playground, then Create Playground to provision a genuinely fresh one
Delete your Trailhead account and sign up again
Install the Sample Gallery, which automatically clears all existing data
Contact Salesforce support to manually wipe the org
questions.explain: The real path to a clean slate is disconnecting the existing playground and creating a brand-new one, which comes back with only default sample data.
